prose: Basis: the Show HN page yielded only fragmentary text, so this note rests on that fragment and the pitch it contains. RainbowSay is a language-learning tool built around the shows you already watch: every sentence of tonight's episode becomes a small lesson with vocabulary and grammar pre-looked-up, spoken practice with one gentle correction at a time, and a streak-and-heatmap view of the hours accumulating. The full feature set and implementation details are not recoverable from the extractable page text.
highlights: RainbowSay turns TV shows into language lessons with vocabulary and grammar pre-looked-up
Spoken practice with one gentle correction per attempt
Streak and heatmap tracking of accumulated practice hours
